There are pink and green wards aside from the sightstones. What is the reasoning behind picking one over the other I haven't really asked anyone, but I typically take green wards because of the cost. I wanted to know if pinks didn't have a timer they were all about their health or what. I'm at work so I can't spend to much time on the comp. but any help with clarifying use situations and explaining why one is better than another in a given situation?
Different Wards but what are the advantages?

Pink wards (100 gold) = last until killed by enemy (or forever.) Limit of 1 active ward placed Green wards (75 gold) = last 3 minutes or until swept by the enemy. Limit of 3 active wards placed

In reality you want to buy a mix of both pink and green wards. If you are playing jungle or supp it never hurts to buy an extra pink ward, even if you have already placed one. For Green Wards try to have 2 down at all times, (or at the very least one)
